subject.title: Browser tool: 7 improvements from real-world automation field test

question: Which remaining browser-tool field-report items should become supported API contracts, and how should they be split for review?
rationale: The unresolved items add or change model-facing browser tool semantics, and the repository policy requires maintainer product judgment for new API surface and focused work boundaries.

options.title: Split remaining API items
options.body: Keep this umbrella open as context and create focused follow-ups for CDP inspection, CAPTCHA signaling, fill verification, and stale-ref/action-result hints before implementation.

options.title: Only document current behavior
options.body: Close out the remaining runtime changes as not planned and improve docs/skill guidance around current selector, batch, aria-ref, and manual-blocker behavior.

options.title: Sponsor a broader browser-tool refresh
options.body: Treat the remaining field report as one maintainer-owned product project with live browser automation proof across managed and existing-session profiles.

recommendation.title: Split remaining API items
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella open as context and create focused follow-ups for CDP inspection, CAPTCHA signaling, fill verification, and stale-ref/action-result hints before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the merged browser act route normalization work that already carried part of this field report into main.
